description: This is a Java source file defining a REST controller (`BillableHoursController`) for managing billable hours in a web API. It provides endpoints to list recent billable hours and to log new entries, utilizing Spring MVC annotations and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: BillableHoursController
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints to retrieve recent billable hours and to log new billable hours.

methods.name: recent
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list recent billable hours with an optional limit parameter.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new billable hour entry.
